newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa uptrend seen intact but not for long.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa uptrend seen intact but not for long.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures uptrend remains intact, but analysts questioned how much longer it could continue.
July cocoa was called to open unchanged on Wednesday after closing up three stg at 1,024 stg a tonne on Tuesday.
July erased early losses to the lowest level since April 10 in the last hour of trade on Tuesday to end at its session high, but traders said buying was light and scattered.
July hit a session low of 1,006 on Tuesday, which independent technical analyst Elli Gifford said was a point on trendline support.
Because July held that support, cocoa had maintained its uptrend, Gifford said. But she noted the upside momentum was slowing.
If July failed to break resistance at 1,045 by the end of the week, cocoa was in danger of a downward reversal, Gifford said.
Gifford said initial July support on Wednesday should surface near 1,015, just above Tuesday's low.
Some traders also said a July close below a bearish trendline near the 15-day moving average around 1,010 and 1,012 would mean more cocoa losses.
Others said a break of 987 would be enough to spin cocoa into a downward spiral because it would probably attract fund sales. The April 9 low is at 980.
